lines.text_source: When I kill, it's all over..._500_ just energy flowing directly into me._300_ But you, little men, you are amusing.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Quando eu mato, acaba tudo..._500_ só energia fluindo direto para mim._300_ Mas vocês, homenzinhos, são divertidos.
lines.risk_notes: Tone must convey menace and supernatural power; avoid comical misinterpretation. Token _500_ and _300_ preserved.

lines.text_source:
You leave behind a shell of what you were and fall to the ground._500_
It brings back memories...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Deixam para trás uma casca do que eram e caem no chão._500_ Isso traz memórias...
lines.risk_notes: Dark/violent content; maintain formal, unsettling tone. Token _500_ preserved. Nostalgia with sinister undertone.

lines.text_source: Isn't it incredible..._300_ what we can do in this place...?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Não é incrível..._300_ o que conseguimos fazer neste lugar...?
lines.risk_notes: Token _300_ preserved. Maintain sense of awe/menace about 'this place'—likely ritual or magical location.

lines.text_source: You did what those poor guys couldn't.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: complimenting player for succeeding where others failed
lines.base_translation: Você fez o que aqueles pobres coitados não conseguiram.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: reacting with disgust to aftermath of battle

lines.text_source: But, to be honest, I didn't come after you just so I could praise you.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: clarifying true motivation for following player
lines.base_translation: Mas, pra ser honesto, não vim atrás de você só pra elogiá-lo.

lines.text_source: I noticed that you're looking for some gems that seem to fit in the entrance door.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Percebi que você está procurando umas gemas que parecem encaixar na porta da entrada.

lines.text_source: I found it before you showed up._300_ My game is stealing treasure, not protecting it. I think it'd be better off in your hands.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: explaining discovery and motivation to help
lines.base_translation: Achei antes de você chegar._300_ Meu jogo é roubar tesouro, não proteger. Acho que fica melhor em suas mãos.
lines.risk_notes: Token _300_ preserved. Sinka's thief mentality and pragmatism.

lines.text_source: We should find the rest to see if that great door can lead us out of here.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: A gente devia achar o resto pra ver se aquela porta gigante consegue nos tirar daqui.
